description: Kind-25050 events checked at 'now' in the room of mesh-signal.json, by the answerer session (by the offerer for 'answer-*' cases). Every event is correctly signed (NIP-01) unless its name says otherwise. 'rejected' MUST be dropped as invalid (NFX-10 §6.5): an implementation fails it at parsing, at the room proof or at decryption. 'ignored' MUST be dropped as not this reader's (another protocol identifier, a type nfx-mesh/1 does not use, or another receiver) without error and before any decryption. 'reason' is informative.

rejected.name: other-room
rejected.reason: P is not the room subscribed to (its proof is valid for that room)

rejected.name: no-roomproof
rejected.reason: every event carries a room proof

rejected.name: roomproof-by-sender
rejected.reason: the room proof is signed by the room key, not the sender

rejected.name: roomproof-other-room
rejected.reason: the room proof is the room's

rejected.name: offer-no-p
rejected.reason: directed events carry exactly one p

rejected.name: offer-plaintext-sdp
rejected.reason: content is NIP-44 v2, never a plaintext SDP
